factor_name: VIX-shock and cross-asset dispersion conditioned 3-day reversal

calculation.expression: when lagged VIX 1-day return exceeds its trailing 60-day 75th percentile AND lagged cross-asset daily return dispersion exceeds its trailing 60-day 75th percentile, use negative 3-day return, median-centered cross-section; otherwise null
calculation.description: A short-term reversal signal activated only during joint volatility and cross-asset dispersion shocks, intended to capture overshoot mean reversion while avoiding unconditional reversal exposure. All conditioning variables are lagged one completed day.

validation.regime_notes: Daily Spearman IC, 15 tradable cross-asset instruments, minimum N=8. Regime IC: 2020-2022 -0.09517 (12 observations), 2023-2024 +0.08935 (11), 2025-2026 +0.11105 (15), 2027 +0.20727 (1). Sparse activation and small regime samples imply conservative uncertainty; joint shock conditioning appears regime-dependent.
